elements.name: Cycle drawing ribbon display by double-clicking its active tab

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes
the Place Views tab shows its full command groups
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab
the ribbon shows compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons
the drawing workspace has more vertical space
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the ribbon shows the group titles in a narrow strip
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the ribbon shows tabs without the group strip
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the full Place Views command groups are visible
the drawing document remains active

elements.name: Double-click an inactive ribbon tab before cycling its display

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
the user double-clicks the inactive Tools tab
Tools becomes the active tab
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab
the Tools ribbon displays panel buttons
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab three more times
the full Tools ribbon is visible again

elements.name: Double-click an inactive tab in tabs-only display

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes
Tools is the active tab in tabs-only ribbon display
the user double-clicks the inactive View tab
View becomes the active tab
its command groups appear in a temporary panel
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary command groups close
View remains the active tab in tabs-only display
the user double-clicks the active View tab
the full View command groups are visible

elements.name: Switch tabs while temporary commands are open in tabs-only mode

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is in tabs-only display with View active
the temporary View command groups are open
the user clicks the Tools tab
Tools becomes the active tab
the temporary Tools command groups replace the View command groups
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary Tools command groups close
Tools remains the active tab in tabs-only display

elements.name: Switch adjacent ribbon tabs with the mouse wheel

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user scrolls down over the Tools tab
Manage becomes the active tab
the full Manage command groups are visible
the user scrolls up over the same position on the tab row
Tools becomes the active tab
the full Tools command groups are visible
the part remains visible

elements.name: Stop wheel navigation at the visible ends of the part ribbon

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon visible
the 3D Model tab is the first visible command tab and is active
the user scrolls up over the 3D Model tab
the 3D Model tab remains active
its command groups remain visible
the user selects the last visible command tab
the user scrolls down over the last visible command tab
the last visible command tab remains active
its command groups remain visible
the part remains visible

the ribbon remains in tabs-only display without opening temporary commands
the user scrolls up over the same position on the tab row

the ribbon remains in tabs-only display without opening temporary commands
